baseline.acceptance_rule: The complete baseline relation-ID set must be a subset of the assembled post-wave corpus.

method: Search specialist Bible layers and active corpus for each proposed corridor.
Prefer enrichment or no-op when the relation's function is already represented.
Promote a new relation only for a distinct function, countertext, ethical constraint or sequence.
Do not create a second relation merely because the same project motif can be renamed.
Run manifest assembly, duplicate checks, reader validation and static/dynamic parity after registration.
